name: Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 (LTE) (Demo Unit)
shortDescription: Open-box demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 (LTE). It has a 22.05 cm (8.7 inch) 90 Hz display, 4G SIM slot, 5,100 mAh battery and microSD support.
description:
This is a demo (display) unit of the Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 (LTE) that was used for in-store demonstration, sold open-box at a lower price. It may show light signs of handling. Please contact us before ordering if you'd like to know its exact condition, the accessories included and the remaining manufacturer warranty.

The Samsung Galaxy Tab A11 (LTE) has a 22.05 cm (8.7 inch) WXGA+ (1340 x 800) TFT display with a refresh rate of 90 Hz. It has an octa-core processor (2.2 GHz + 2 GHz) with 4 GB or 8 GB RAM and 64 GB or 128 GB storage, and takes a microSD card of up to 2 TB.

It has a single 4G LTE SIM slot, dual-band Wi-Fi (802.11 ac), Bluetooth 5.3, a 3.5 mm headphone jack, an 8 MP rear camera and a 5 MP front camera. The battery is 5,100 mAh (typical), and the tablet weighs 337 g.
